description:
Contractors who pull permits in the Twin Cities, how active they are, and who does structural work, from permit records. Give an address to see who works around it. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Which contractors do the most permitted work near 4500 France Ave S?"
- "Who does structural work in Saint Paul?"

address.description: A street address inside the seven-county metro, to answer about ONE property instead of the whole market. Include the city after a comma when the street name is common — 'Grand Ave' exists in several of these cities.

cut.description: active: still pulling permits; all: every firm; structural: structural work; busy: ten or more permits. Default active.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: find_a_contractor
title: Find a Contractor
